auth.label: API Key
auth.description: Happy Scribe API key sent as a Bearer token. Get it from the API section of your account at https://www.happyscribe.com/account.

actions.name: confirm_order
actions.description: Confirm a previously created Happy Scribe order so processing can begin.

orderId.description: The unique identifier of the Happy Scribe order.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for confirming a Happy Scribe order.

confirmed.description: Whether Happy Scribe accepted the order confirmation.

orderId.description: The unique identifier of the Happy Scribe order.

outputSchema.description: The response returned when confirming a Happy Scribe order.

actions.name: create_export
actions.description: Create an asynchronous export for one or more Happy Scribe transcriptions.

items.description: The unique identifier of the Happy Scribe transcription.

transcriptionIds.description: The transcription identifiers included in the export.

format.description: The export format, such as txt, srt, vtt, json, csv, or docx.

showTimestamps.description: Whether to include timestamps in the export.

showSpeakers.description: Whether to include speaker names in the export.

showComments.description: Whether to include comments in the export.

showHighlights.description: Whether to include highlights in the export.

inputSchema.description: The input payload for creating a Happy Scribe export.

anyOf.description: The unique identifier of the export.

id.description: The unique identifier of the export.

anyOf.description: The current processing state of the export.

state.description: The current processing state of the export.

anyOf.description: The requested export format.
The temporary download URL when the export is ready.

download_link.description: The temporary download URL when the export is ready.

export.description: A Happy Scribe export and its current state.

outputSchema.description: The response returned when creating a Happy Scribe export.

actions.name: create_transcription_order

confirm.description: Whether to submit the order for processing immediately.

isSubtitle.description: Whether the order should produce subtitles.

webhookUrl.description: The URL Happy Scribe should notify when processing changes.

tags.description: The tags to attach to the transcription.

order.description: A Happy Scribe order and its current processing state.

outputSchema.description: The response returned when creating a transcription order.
